title: 第1章 苏铭
content_zh:
一片连绵不绝的大山，如龙脊延伸，弥漫在这苍茫的大地上，其内草木众多，更有鸟兽之声不断回旋。

远远一看，山脉上凸起的部分组成了五座山峰，如同人的五指抬起，要抓向天空一样，其中一座山峰中段，一块凹进去的大石上，有一个少年人正靠在阴凉处，身边放着一个编篓，里面堆积着一些药草，散发出阵阵药香，缭绕四周。

那少年眉清目秀，只是身子单薄，看起来略有羸弱之意，穿着一件由兽皮缝制的小衫，脖子上挂着一圈白色的月牙兽骨，头发有些杂乱，被其随意的用草绳束着。

他坐在那里，手中拿着一卷十多张兽皮粘在一起的革书，在那里津津有味，摇头读着。

“蛮族有祖，开天造人，遗留万代至今……持蛮者称蛮士，飞天入地移山倒海……有蛮纹通天，可摘取日月星辰……”少年读着读着，叹了口气。

“没有蛮体，如何成蛮……蛮士……蛮士……苏铭，你也就只能采些草药，成为部落里的凡医罢了，想成为修蛮的蛮士，遥遥无期。”少年自嘲，放下了手中的兽皮卷，看着远处的天地，发起呆来。

这卷兽皮，他已经看了不知道多少遍，不说倒背如流，也相差无几。

“天似圆，地若方，如无边，仿无际……”苏铭喃喃中，脑子里幻想着那书卷里的世界，不知不觉的，天色渐暗，可以看到远处天地尽头处似有乌云若隐若现。

吹来的山风，也带着了一股潮气，落在那山上的诸多草木树叶上，发出哗啦哗啦的声响。

在看到那天边乌云的一瞬，苏铭忽然精神一振。

“阿公推算的果然准确，今天真有乌龙涎！”苏铭双眼露出明亮之芒，他快速的站起身，将手中兽皮卷塞入怀里，左手一把抓起身边的编篓背在背上，身子一晃，极为灵巧的抓着一旁的草绳索，向着山顶爬去。

远远一看，这少年羸弱的身子，却是爆发出了极为坚韧的力量，若猿猴一般，几个起跃之间，就攀出了十多丈远。

天地间的乌云，滚滚而来，更有轰鸣之声回旋，仿若天怒降临在这片山脉之上，那乌云连接天地，漆黑一片，转眼就越来越近了。

苏铭此刻攀爬更快，几乎就是在这乌云扩散而来的一瞬，他已然攀临到了距离山顶约数十丈的位置，那里有一大块凸起的怪石，似天然而成，其内中空，有无数拳头大小的洞口，这怪石整体的样子，若一条盘踞在此地与山峰融合的巨蟒之首。

那怪石下，还有如獠牙的锥形，看起来触目惊心，颇为奇异，且因其是从山体上凸出的部位，几乎若悬空一般，很难攀爬过去，除非可以升空飞行。

苏铭左手抓着绳索，右手从背后的编篓里取出一个小瓶放在嘴上咬着，慢慢挪动身子，向着那怪石相反的方向，移动了数丈，使得其左手抓着的绳索也倾斜起来后，五指扣住山壁，身子紧贴，抬头看着天空的乌云，目光炯炯，一动不动。

片刻后，乌云盖顶，雷霆之声轰轰而起，震耳欲聋中，狂风肆虐，吹动这山脉似都欲要拔地而起一般，苏铭在这狂风中，扣住山壁的五指已然发白，但却纹丝未动，看向天空的双眼内，露出了坚韧。

那狂风越来越大，吹动这山脉草木，声响如巨兽之吼，更是将这山脉上的无数枯枝烂叶大都卷起，使得漫天遍地，全部都是草木树叶在急速飞舞。

甚至还有一些大块的枯木与小兽，也都被生生卷起，旋转中被远远抛开，发出的凄厉惨叫，也被隐藏在了那风声之中。

在这狂风中苏铭坚持了不多时，整个天空已然被乌云完全遮盖，雷鸣下，豆大的雨滴倾盆而落，整个天地在这一瞬间，似成为了被水帘遮盖的世界。

雨水哗哗，不断地落下，越来越大，苏铭依旧死死的抓着被雨水浸湿的绳索，贴着山壁，任由雨水淋透了全身，仍然一动不动，盯着那如蟒蛇之兽的怪石下，一处凸起的若獠牙之岩。

也不知过去了多久，那雨依旧渐增，天地一片雨雾蒙蒙，那被苏铭盯着的獠牙之岩，却是慢慢在雨水的冲洗下，泌出了黑色的**。

那黑液与雨水融合，连成了一条水线，向着下方流淌。

苏铭看着这一幕，双目露出喜色，但却依旧不动，直至那泌出的黑液渐渐稀少，最终赫然化作了金色的一瞬间，苏铭双目一凝，没有丝毫迟疑，猛的松开了扣住山石的右手，身子滑落时他右手立刻从嘴边取下了那小瓶。

他左手抓着的绳索本就倾斜，此刻随着其右手松开，整个人如同荡起一样，随着那绳索以极快的速度直奔那凸起的獠牙之岩而去。

因之前那绳索倾斜的弧度极大，且他把握的位置又颇为准确，此刻几乎是雷霆轰鸣间，苏铭已然随着绳索来到了若悬空的獠牙之岩旁边，其左手抓着绳索，右手拿着小土瓶，临近的刹那，快速的放在那獠牙之岩下，借着那绳索回荡到了极限后一顿的时间，生生装满了大半瓶金色的**。

但就在这时，却听一声声尖锐的嘶鸣蓦然而起，约有四五条足有手臂粗细，半丈之长的黑色蜈蚣，赫然从那怪石上诸多的拳头大小的洞口内钻出，狰狞的直奔那荡在半空的苏铭扑去。

苏铭没有丝毫意外，几乎就是在那些蜈蚣出现的一瞬，他立刻松开了抓着绳索的左手，身子以极快的速度立刻下坠，避开了那些蜈蚣的扑击。

“小红！”苏铭整个人在半空急速下坠，那狂风如刀子让其身子瞬间有了僵硬，尽管避开了那些蜈蚣，可如今一旦落下，将会立刻成为肉泥一般。

可他却没有惊慌，只见一道红影从旁边的山崖上抓着一道绳索一冲而出，直奔苏铭下坠的身子而来，瞬息临近，一把拉住了苏铭，那红影是一只红色的小猴，此刻呲牙咧嘴，但眼中却是露出灵动。

一人一猴，随着绳索落在了山崖壁上，也就是之前那苏铭读书的地方后，那苏铭眼中露出紧张，立刻收起始终抓着的小土瓶。

“小红，我们要快跑，这次我抢的乌龙涎太多了！咦，你手里抓着什么东西？”苏铭说着，看到了那小猴爪子里握着一小块黑黝黝的碎片。

那小猴立刻神色露出警惕，爪子放在身后，连连嘶吼了几声，苏铭见时间紧迫，不再多言，而是立刻向前快走几步，身子一跃而下，抓着一条条绳索，与那小猴一起飞速向下而去。

在他们身后，嘶鸣之声滔天而起，却见那数只黑色的蜈蚣顺着岩壁快速追来，如多道黑线滑落，紧追不断。

那红色的小猴连连呲牙，不断的向着身边的苏铭嘶叫，红影闪闪间，时而回头看向后方追来的那些蜈蚣，目中露出害怕与愤愤之色。

“又不是第一次这般逃跑，那些乌龙不敢下山，你就别装了，老规矩，这些乌龙涎分你一小半。”苏铭急速逃遁中，话语却显得懒洋洋的，果然此话一出口，那小猴立刻眉开眼笑，显然之前的一切都是装出来的。

这一人一猴，对于这山脉极为熟悉，再加上那些蜈蚣不知为何，此山有些地方似不敢直接闯过，而是绕行而去，如此一来，那苏铭与小猴逃遁速度尽管没有那些蜈蚣快速，但他们却是时而直接向下一跳，往往都可以抓到一条绳索，几次之后，便下了山峰，钻入丛林内，不见踪影了。

那些蜈蚣果然不敢下山，嘶吼了许久，这才带着不甘，重新爬上山顶去了。

乌云来的快，去也同样匆匆，数个时辰后，这片山脉就恢复了正常，那乌云滚滚，向着远处蔓延离去。

丛林边缘，苏铭与小猴走了出来，此刻天色已然渐黑，可以看到远处的天边有些微弱的火光，那里正是苏铭所在的部落。

“分给你的小半都被你喝了，你还想要？”走出丛林，苏铭全身湿漉漉的，但却不以为意，而是似笑非笑的看着那一直跟在身后，眼巴巴望着自己的小猴。

这小猴极为通灵，是他在三年前进入此山时无意中发现，彼此还发生过一些矛盾，最终却是成为了好友。

小猴眨了眨眼，挠了挠脸，露出一丝挣扎犹豫，但很快它就把手中方才抓着的那一块漆黑的碎片递给苏铭，连连嘶吼了几句，表达出了要换那乌龙涎的意思。

“好吧，再给你一些，不过这破石头我不要，你留着吧。”苏铭笑了起来，从编篓里取下那小土瓶，递给了小猴。

这小猴连忙抓过来，喝了一口，脸上露出陶醉之意，身子更是晃悠了几下后，打出了一个酒嗝，把手中的那黑色石头碎片连同小瓶都扔给苏铭后，晃着身子几个闪跃，就消失在了丛林内。

苏铭看着只剩下小半的土瓶，微微一笑，也不介意就放回了背后的编篓内，打量起那块漆黑的石头碎片来。
content_en:
An endless stretch of mountains, extending like a dragon's spine, permeates the vast land. There are many plants and trees in it, and the sounds of birds and beasts are constantly reverberating.

From a distance, we can see that the convex part of the mountain range forms five peaks, just like a person's five fingers raised to grasp the sky. In the middle of one of the peaks, on a large concave rock, there is a young man leaning in the shade. There is a basket beside him, with some medicinal herbs piled inside, exuding bursts of medicinal fragrance, lingering around.

The young man had good features, but he was thin and looked a little frail. He was wearing a small shirt sewn from animal skins, with a white crescent animal bone hanging around his neck. His hair was a little messy and was tied up casually with a straw rope.

He sat there, holding a leather book with more than ten animal skins stuck together in his hand, reading with relish, shaking his head.

"The barbarians have ancestors who opened the sky and created humans, leaving them for generations to this day... Those who hold barbarism are called barbarians, they fly into the sky and move mountains and seas... There are barbarian patterns reaching the sky, and they can pick off the sun, moon and stars..." The young man read and sighed.

"How can you become a barbarian without a barbarian body... a barbarian... a barbarian... Su Ming, you can only collect some herbs and become a mortal doctor in the tribe. It's a long way to go to become a barbarian practicing barbarism." The young man laughed at himself, put down the animal skin roll in his hand, looked at the world in the distance, and became stunned.

He had read this roll of animal skin countless times, not to mention memorizing it by heart, but it was almost the same.

"The sky is round, the earth is square, it is boundless, it seems boundless..." Su Ming murmured, imagining the world in the book in his mind. Unknowingly, the sky was getting dark, and he could see dark clouds looming at the end of the sky and the earth in the distance.

The mountain breeze also brought a sense of moisture, which fell on the leaves of many plants and trees on the mountain, making a rustling sound.

The moment he saw the dark clouds on the other side, Su Ming suddenly became energetic.

"Grandpa's calculation is indeed accurate. There is really something wrong today!" Su Ming's eyes flashed brightly. He stood up quickly, stuffed the animal skin roll in his hand into his arms, grabbed the knitted basket beside him with his left hand and carried it on his back. With a sway of his body, he grabbed the grass rope on the side with great dexterity and climbed towards the top of the mountain.

Looking from a distance, this young man's frail body burst out with extremely tenacious strength. Like an ape, he climbed more than ten feet in a few leaps.

The dark clouds between the sky and the earth are rolling in, and there is a roaring sound, as if the wrath of the sky has descended on this mountain range. The dark clouds connect the sky and the earth, and it is pitch black, and they are getting closer and closer in the blink of an eye.

Su Ming was climbing faster at this moment. Almost at the moment when the dark clouds spread, he had already climbed to a position about tens of feet away from the top of the mountain. There was a large raised strange rock, which seemed to be natural. It was hollow inside and had countless holes the size of fists. The overall appearance of this strange rock was like the head of a giant python entrenched here and fused with the mountain peak.

Under the strange rock, there is a cone like a fang, which looks shocking and strange. Moreover, because it is a protruding part from the mountain, it almost looks like it is hanging in the air. It is difficult to climb over it unless you can take off and fly.

Su Ming grabbed the rope with his left hand, took out a small bottle from the basket behind his back with his right hand, put it to his mouth and bit it. He slowly moved his body in the opposite direction of the strange rock, moving a few feet so that the rope he was holding on to his left hand tilted up. He clasped the mountain wall with his fingers and stayed close to it. He looked up at the dark clouds in the sky, his eyes bright and motionless.

A moment later, dark clouds covered the sky, and the sound of thunder boomed. The deafening wind was raging, and the mountains seemed to be about to rise from the ground. In this strong wind, Su Ming's five fingers holding the mountain wall turned white, but he did not move at all. The eyes that looked at the sky showed tenacity.

The strong wind was getting stronger and stronger, blowing the grass and trees in the mountain range, making a sound like the roar of a giant beast, and rolling up countless dead branches and leaves on the mountain range, making the grass, trees and leaves flying rapidly all over the sky.

Even some large pieces of dead wood and small animals were rolled up and thrown far away in the rotation, and their screams were also hidden in the sound of the wind.

After Su Ming persisted in this strong wind for a short time, the entire sky was completely covered by dark clouds. Under the thunder, huge raindrops fell in torrents. At this moment, the entire world seemed to have become a world covered by a curtain of water.

The rain continued to fall, getting heavier and heavier. Su Ming still clung to the rope soaked by the rain and clung to the mountain wall. He let the rain soak through his body and remained motionless, staring at a protruding fang-like rock under the strange rock that looked like a python.

I don't know how much time has passed, but the rain is still increasing, and the world is covered with rain and fog. The Fang Rock that Su Ming is staring at is slowly secreting black liquid under the wash of the rain.

The black liquid merged with the rainwater and formed a water line, flowing downward.

Su Ming looked at this scene, his eyes were filled with joy, but he remained motionless until the secreted black liquid gradually became less and less, and finally turned into a golden color. Su Ming's eyes were focused, and without any hesitation, he suddenly released his right hand that was holding the rock. When his body slipped, he immediately took the vial from his mouth with his right hand.

The rope he was holding with his left hand was already tilted. Now as his right hand was released, his whole body seemed to be swinging, and the rope was heading straight towards the protruding Fang Rock at an extremely fast speed.

Because the arc of the rope's inclination was extremely large before, and the position he grasped was quite accurate, at this moment, almost with the roar of thunder, Su Ming had followed the rope to the side of the Fang Rock, which seemed to be hanging in the air. He grabbed the rope with his left hand and the small earth bottle in his right hand. At the moment of approaching, he quickly placed it under the Fang Rock. After the rope echoed to the limit, he filled most of the bottle with golden liquid.

But at this moment, a sharp neighing sound suddenly erupted, and about four or five black centipedes, as thick as an arm and half a foot long, suddenly emerged from the many fist-sized holes in the strange rock, and ferociously rushed towards Su Ming, who was hanging in the air.

Su Ming was not surprised at all. Almost as soon as those centipedes appeared, he immediately released his left hand holding the rope, and his body immediately fell at an extremely fast speed, avoiding the attacks of those centipedes.

"Xiaohong!" Su Ming fell rapidly in mid-air. The strong wind like a knife made his body stiff instantly. Although he avoided those centipedes, once he fell, he would immediately turn into meat.

But he did not panic. He saw a red figure rushing out from the nearby cliff grabbing a rope and heading straight for Su Ming's falling body. It approached in an instant and grabbed Su Ming. The red figure was a little red monkey. It grinned at the moment, but its eyes were full of intelligence.

One person and one monkey followed the rope and landed on the mountain cliff, where Su Ming was studying before. Su Ming's eyes showed nervousness and he immediately put away the small earthen bottle he had been holding on to.

"Xiao Hong, we have to run quickly. I grabbed too much saliva this time! Hey, what are you holding in your hand?" Su Ming said and saw a small black fragment in the little monkey's paw.

The little monkey immediately looked alert, put his paws behind him, and roared several times. Seeing that time was running out, Su Ming stopped talking and immediately took a few steps forward, jumped down, grabbed the ropes, and flew down with the little monkey.

Behind them, a roaring sound rose into the sky, and they saw several black centipedes chasing quickly along the rock wall, like multiple black lines sliding down, chasing after them continuously.

The little red monkey bared its teeth and kept hissing at Su Ming beside him. The red shadow flashed, and sometimes he looked back at the centipedes chasing behind him, with fear and anger in his eyes.

"It's not the first time I've run away like this. Those oolongs don't dare to go down the mountain, so stop pretending. As a rule, you get a small share of these oolongs." Su Ming fled quickly, but his words seemed lazy. As expected, as soon as he said these words, the little monkey immediately beamed. Obviously everything before was just an act.

This man and the monkey were very familiar with this mountain range. In addition, for some reason, the centipedes seemed to dare not go directly through some parts of the mountain, but instead went around. In this way, although Su Ming and the little monkey did not escape as fast as those centipedes, they sometimes jumped directly down, and they could often catch a rope. After a few times, they descended the mountain peak, got into the jungle, and disappeared.

As expected, those centipedes did not dare to go down the mountain. After roaring for a long time, they climbed up to the top of the mountain again with unwillingness.

The dark clouds came and went just as quickly. After a few hours, the mountain range returned to normal, and the dark clouds rolled away and spread into the distance.

At the edge of the jungle, Su Ming and the little monkey walked out. It was getting dark now, and some faint firelight could be seen on the horizon in the distance. That was the tribe where Su Ming belonged.

"You drank half of what was given to you, do you still want it?" Su Ming walked out of the jungle, his whole body was wet, but he didn't care. Instead, he looked at the little monkey who had been following him with a half-smile, looking at him eagerly.

This little monkey is extremely psychic. He accidentally discovered it when he entered this mountain three years ago. They had some conflicts with each other, but they eventually became good friends.

The little monkey blinked and scratched its face, showing a trace of struggle and hesitation, but soon it handed the dark fragment it had just grasped to Su Ming and roared a few times, expressing its intention to exchange it for the black dragon saliva.

"Okay, I'll give you some more, but I don't want this broken stone. You can keep it." Su Ming laughed, took out the small earthen bottle from the basket, and handed it to the little monkey.

The little monkey quickly grabbed it and took a sip, with an intoxicated look on his face. After swaying a few times, he let out a wine burp and threw the black stone fragments and the vial in his hand to Su Ming. He swayed a few times and disappeared into the jungle.

Su Ming looked at the small half of the earthen vase, smiled slightly, put it back into the basket behind him without caring, and looked at the pitch-black stone fragment.
